etsyPackage.title: Good Things Take Time Mug, Positive Affirmation Mug, Floral Self Care Gift, Inspirational Coffee Cup, Gift for Her
etsyPackage.description:
A cheerful daily reminder for slow mornings, busy desks and everything in between. This original Kenvori 11 oz ceramic mug features the uplifting phrase “Good Things Take Time” surrounded by colorful folk-inspired flowers, a smiling sun and a relaxed little cat.

Designed as an everyday encouragement mug and an easy-to-give gift for a friend, coworker, sister or anyone who could use a brighter moment. The wraparound artwork keeps the mug colorful from more than one angle while the main message stays clear and readable from the front.

DETAILS
• 11 oz white ceramic mug
• Full-color wraparound design
• Original Kenvori artwork
• Made to order by our production partner
• Suitable for coffee, tea and everyday hot drinks

GIFT IDEAS
Birthday • encouragement • self-care • coworker • friendship • Christmas • just because

Please note that colors can vary slightly between screens and the finished printed product.
